findings.title: Buffer Overflow
findings.trigger: Sending a packet larger than sizeof(uint32_t) from the client
findings.assumptions: The recvfrom function does not check the size of the incoming packet, and the buffer is not dynamically sized.

findings.title: Integer Overflow or Wraparound
findings.trigger: Inputting a value that exceeds the range of uint32_t
findings.assumptions: The input is not validated to ensure it fits within the range of uint32_t.

findings.title: OS Command Injection
findings.trigger: Inputting a value that could be interpreted as a command by the shell
findings.assumptions: The input is not properly sanitized before being used in a system call.

findings.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
findings.trigger: Inputting a value that could be interpreted as a command by the shell
findings.assumptions: The input is not properly sanitized before being used in a system call.
